_guia: Los libros. Cada bloque de 'items' es un libro y tiene su propia página. Para añadir uno, copiar un bloque entero y cambiarle los valores. 'categoria' agrupa los libros en las pestañas de arriba — si se escribe una categoría nueva, la pestaña aparece sola. 'shape' es la forma de la portada, y hay tres, las mismas de todo el sitio: 'cuadrado', 'alto' (más alta que ancha, que es lo normal en un libro) o 'ancho' (más ancha que alta, como un infantil apaisado). Si se deja vacía o mal escrita, sale 'alto'. En la portada del sitio salen los tres primeros de esta lista.
title: Books
lead: Novels for adults, illustrated stories for the little ones and books of poetry. All of them are published and available on Amazon.
_guiaGeneros: Los géneros de los libros, en el orden de las pestañas. La 'categoria' de cada libro se elige de esta lista. Un género quitado de aquí deja de tener pestaña: los libros que todavía lo lleven salen igual, solo en 'Todos'.

items.title: New York casi devora a mis Abuelos
items.tagline: Two grandparents land in New York without speaking the language, and the city nearly swallows them whole.
items.synopsis:
A grandmother and grandfather leave the calm of their South American city and land in New York. The Big Apple greets them as a maze of skyscrapers, noise and customs they don't understand.

With nothing but their wits and their courage for a compass, and the language against them, they set out to conquer the city amid the chaos of the subway and the everyday misunderstandings.

A novel about what it takes to start over far from home, told without losing its sense of humor.
items._nota: Si hay un fragmento del libro que quiera mostrar, va en 'excerpt'. Si se deja vacío, esa parte no sale.

items.title: Iván el Guía
items.tagline: A tour guide who turns every trip into an adventure.
items.synopsis:
Iván is a fun, curious guide, always with his backpack on and a story for every corner. He leads tourists who have come from all over the world.

On every tour, children learn something about history, culture and friendship, and discover the joy of traveling without any suitcases at all.

The fourth book in the Box of Dreams Collection.

items.title: Chánir y Mayaluca
items.tagline: Two curious creatures who wander from home to find where they belong.
items.synopsis:
Not every path is already laid out: some are built step by step. Chánir and Mayaluca set off on an unexpected journey through a city full of surprises.

They discover that sometimes you have to go far away to find what you were looking for, and that home can be where you least expected it.

A fable about courage and friendship.

items.title: Sueños y Fantasías
items.tagline: Poems for children in which words turn into animals, butterflies and songs.
items.synopsis:
A journey in verse through the imagination of the little ones. On every page, words become animals, stars and songs.

Dreams dress up as rainbows and wishes sail beyond the moon.

It is made to be read aloud, especially at bedtime.

items.title: En el Corazón del Bosque
items.tagline: A stubborn little bear wanders too far and has to find her way back.
items.synopsis:
Mama Bear and her two cubs wake from the long winter sleep and go out walking among the trees and streams. The most headstrong little bear strays from the group and ends up alone.

In the middle of the vast forest she will have to face her fears and learn that pride and willfulness make you lose your way.

The third book in the Box of Dreams Collection.

items.title: Teresa & the two Puppies
items.tagline: The English edition of «Teresita y los dos Ositos».
items.synopsis:
The same story of Teresita, told in English for those who read in that language: a woman who lives alone and finds company in two Bichon Frisé puppies.

Between games and laughter she discovers that true magic lies in the simplest bonds.

Part of the Box of Dreams Collection.

items.title: Bella
items.tagline: A white dove learns that being different is nothing to hide.
items.synopsis:
Bella is teased for her unusual feathers, and she decides to hide who she is to avoid being rejected.

An unexpected contest puts her at the center of everyone's gaze, and there she discovers that her strength lay precisely in what makes her different.

The second book in the Box of Dreams Collection.

items.title: Teresita y los dos Ositos
items.tagline: A woman on her own, two puppies, and a house that fills with laughter.
items.synopsis:
Teresita leads a quiet life until two little Bichon Frisé puppies arrive, full of energy and tenderness.

With their games they change her days and teach her to look at life with a new joy.

The first book in the Box of Dreams Collection.

items.title: Jardín de Ilusiones
items.tagline: Poems about love, about what lasts only a little while, and about wishes left unfulfilled.
items.synopsis:
An illustrated book of poems, written to be read slowly.

It speaks of the beauty of what passes and does not return, of love in its purest form, and of the hopes we keep without telling anyone.

items.title: Sueños de mi Niñez
items.tagline: Poems to read aloud, with a child beside you.
items.synopsis:
A children's book full of charming poems that invites the little ones — and the grown-ups — on a magical journey through the imagination.

It is the key to a world where anything is possible.

items.title: Secretos tras los Muros
items.tagline: Luciana grows up amid poverty and violence, and becomes strong in spite of it all.
items.synopsis:
Luciana is born into a poor, close-knit home that is marked by violence. Her character takes shape in that daily struggle.

She sets out on a search that takes her from religious life to love as a couple, sustained by her faith and by her own superstitions.

She goes through humiliations, some at the hands of people close to her, and comes out of each one with a firmer spirit.

items.title: ¡Yo exterminé al último hombre!
items.tagline: A virus that kills only men, and a world left in the hands of a cruel woman.
items.synopsis:
Lorenzo and Nathalie invent something that could improve life on Earth, and ambitious hands will do anything to take it.

At the same time a strange virus is spreading that affects only men and threatens to wipe out humanity.

An adventure of survival in a new world, ruled without mercy.

items.title: La reliquia: Invasión mortal
items.tagline: A family, an ancient relic, and a world no one had ever imagined.
items.synopsis:
Carolina, Prince and Ashley are caught up in an unprecedented adventure when the magic of an ancient relic leaves them somewhere they never imagined.

Guided by a remarkable character, they travel through beautiful and dangerous places, face extraordinary beings and search for a way back home. Terror and happiness arrive together.

A thrilling, one-of-a-kind adventure, full of lessons and revelations.

items.title: El ojo de la muerte
items.tagline: A novel about revenge, and about what is left of our humanity when everything is against us.
items.synopsis:
Luis Mendoza grows up amid poverty and abuse, and witnesses his mother's murder. From then on he is driven by one thing only: revenge.

The novel follows him through trials, adventures and the struggle to survive, until true love enters his life and forces him to choose — a decision that marks him forever.

It is a harsh portrait of a society that punishes, told without softening anything, and at the same time a story of resilience, growth and forgiveness.

upcoming._guia: Los libros que todavía no salen. Es un solo bloque, como el poema de la portada: un texto y una imagen al lado. En 'body' va todo el texto — una línea en blanco separa un párrafo del siguiente. Si se deja 'body' vacío, la sección entera desaparece.
upcoming.title: What's next
upcoming._nota: Cuando sepa cuál es el próximo libro, se nombra aquí. Mientras tanto queda este texto general; si se vacía 'body', la sección entera desaparece.
upcoming.body:
She keeps on writing. There are more finished books waiting their turn at the printer — novels, children's stories and poetry.

Each time a new one comes out, it is added to this list.
